title: hello
author: Successful_Wolf542
selftext:
Hi people, I hope yall are doing great, im doing very decent actually

since time ago I started working on my game called tick tock toss

Tick Tock Toss is a 2D party game I'm making in Godot. It's basically soccer, but the ball is a bomb that blows up every 7–15 seconds, so you have to kick it toward your opponent before it goes off in your face. Matches are best of 5 rounds and get wilder as they go: sudden death, ice bombs, sticky bombs, bombs that split in two, and fields that shrink. Each player picks a power, like a speed dash, a shield that bounces the bomb back, a magnet to steal it, or a ghost mode that makes you immune to the blast. There are 5 maps, from a pinball arena to an icy rink and a factory with conveyor belts. You can play against a bot (4 difficulty levels) or with a friend on the same keyboard, and unlock tons of cosmetics like shapes, colors, hats, emotes and titles. Everything you buy is cosmetic, so there's no pay-to-win.

I started working on this game since a month ago and im going to say this

a lot of parts of the game are make by AI

im not proud of making it with AI, I didnt like it, and I tried my best to make everything I could make alone

but eventually there were parts I didnt know how to do it

so... i went to my worst enemy, AI.

But I like how is going so far, and Im looking for people opinion.. Is not complete yet, I still have to work through important things, but I want to know if my game can be in the people interest

what I can add? what should I take off?

comments.author: DrElectro
comments.body: This looks like it has an overwhelmingly complex meta game while at the same time is presenting a gameplay one would suspect from a game jam. The idea itself sounds fun but it looks like you prioritized the wrong parts of that game.

replies.author: DrElectro
replies.body: Like I wrote: You built the meta game before creating a compelling actual gameplay.

replies.author: Successful_Wolf542
replies.body:
I mean, the gameplay is almost done, I just have to fix the types of bombs

but in general is done in most ways

replies.author: DrElectro
replies.body: But the gameplay I see is not selling me your game. Why would I care about all your meta, when all I can do is playing a game, which looks like a Start-Me-Once on Crazygames. I would've closed it as soon I have to click more than one Button. Don't you see that?
